# STI Firestop

> STI Firestop delivers comprehensive fire protection and cable management solutions including SpecSeal firestop products and EZ-Path cable pathways for healthcare, finance, and data communication markets.

Specified Technologies Inc. (STI) provides UL/cUL-certified firestop systems, intumescent foam blocks, spray applications, and cable pathway solutions for building safety and compliance. The company serves global markets through regional offices, technical support, and an online submittal builder tool.

## Key Topics

- STI Firestop
- SpecSeal firestop products
- EZ-Path cable pathways
- Fire-rated products
- Firestop systems
- Cable management
- Fire protection
- UL/cUL specifications
- Installation guides
- Healthcare facilities
- Data communications
- BIM objects
- Curtain wall systems
- Firestopping solutions
- LEED compliance

## Core Products & Solutions

- [SpecSeal Firestop Block](https://www.stifirestop.com/products/specseal-firestop-block): SpecSeal intumescent foam block product specifications and installation guide.
- [SpecSeal Quick Clip Field Installation System](https://www.stifirestop.com/products/specseal-quick-clip-field-installation-system): SpecSeal Quick Clip curtain wall insulation system product specifications.
- [SpeedFlex TTG Track Top Gasket](https://www.stifirestop.com/products/speedflex-ttg-track-top-gasket): SpeedFlex track top gasket for gypsum board construction firestopping.
- [EZ-Path Series 44NEZ Smoke & Acoustical Pathway](https://www.stifirestop.com/products/ez-path-series-44nez-smoke-acoustical-pathway): EZ-Path Series 44NEZ smoke and acoustical cable pathway specifications.

## Technical Resources & Tools

- [Firestop System Search & Submittals](https://systems.stifirestop.com): Submittal builder tool for firestop systems search and UL/cUL specifications.
- [Access STI](https://access.stifirestop.com): Portal for firestop tools, guides, BIM objects, and Firestop University.
- [EZ-Path Ordering & Installation](https://www.stifirestop.com/ez-path/ordering-and-installation): EZ-Path cable pathway ordering and installation guide with specifications.

## Market Solutions

- [Healthcare Facilities](https://www.stifirestop.com/markets-we-serve/data-communication/healthcare): EZ-Path firestop solutions for HIPAA-compliant healthcare facilities.
- [Finance & Critical Infrastructure](https://www.stifirestop.com/markets-we-serve/data-communication/finance-insurance): EZ-Path firestop solutions for financial institutions and critical infrastructure.
